entries.title: Review Finding Grades
entries.compatibility: Additive multi-source grades with immutable source keys; explicit historical backfill and atomic batch settlement writes. Explicit manifest remediation consumes grades; no live review or merge predicate consumes them. Backfill excludes decisions already graded at settlement; lifecycle grade kind agrees across paths. Projection/backfill writers acquire IMMEDIATE write locks before reads; finding and grade backfills commit per pass and optionally report committed inserts through onPass. Safe live finding projection retries busy once.

entries.title: Review Finding Records
entries.store: data/reviews.db: review_findings, review_finding_replies, review_finding_remediations, review_finding_disputes, finding_backlog, finding_batches, finding_batch_notes, finding_batch_releases
entries.owner: review-body capture and remediation completion observations
entries.compatibility: FINDINGSSTUCK-01: additive replay-safe finding_batches.batch_attempts counts returned invalid initial receipts separately from per-finding release attempts. Failed dispatch subprocesses preserve that counter and retry the same batch/key without a finding charge. Legacy ambiguous errors reset the old counter once. Overdue retries report needs-operator; actual releases retain their existing requeue/exhaustion audit. Projection/backfill writers acquire IMMEDIATE write locks before reads; finding and grade backfills commit per pass and optionally report committed inserts through onPass. Safe live finding projection retries busy once. Historical projections insert historical_projection=1 on findings and notes; automatic candidate views exclude them, while explicit manifests retain enrollment authority. First automatic claims use the configured source merge-age window; released automatic findings remain eligible until settlement or retry exhaustion. Summaries use the health-configured window, expose outOfWindow without mutating skipped rows, and alert on expired never-claimed work. Historical body repair and link CLI use the same projection marker; a genuine live projection can activate matching historical observations, including at verified merge capture. OSGBACKFILLENROLL-01 advisory remediation: bounded repo-scoped operator expiry disposition retains dropped/out-of-window rationale and resolved_at without a correctness grade; selected, owned and retried findings are excluded. Summary areas exclude unassigned historical/expired advice and expose notesHistorical/notesOutOfWindow. Live replay enrolls only actual historical-to-live promotions. Pre-migration observations keep the live-default marker and rely on the claim-age window. PUBLISHINTENTSTRAND-01: collector publish-intent.json adds submittedAt, dispatchTimeoutMs and resubmissionCount; one atomic same-key replacement records resubmitOf after the submission deadline plus configured grace and proven absent publisher with all keyed launches terminal. Legacy intents use mtime/current timeout; publisher receipts, live/unknown/unreadable custody fence retries, and a second absence preserves stale release accounting. No SQLite schema or outcome shape changes. FINDINGSDECISIONHOLD-01: additive nullable finding_batches.decision_publication_json binds a supported no-continuation decision supersession and branch-release receipt to source launch/batch/repo/branch/tested head before publisher dispatch. Interrupted handoffs recover through the same API. Unresolved decision custody prevents stale batch release. Error rows remain bounded to 300 characters and prefer the refusal cause; watcher logs retain redacted full stderr once per failure. A verified handoff permits one post-deadline replacement of a spent pre-handoff intent: decisionPublication binds that epoch and handoffOf retains the old submission. The epoch cannot reset itself; keyed custody is re-read after the lifecycle call. FINDINGSBATCHSTRAND-01: additive nullable finding_batches.hold_json records the latest needs-operator decision {reason,error,heldAt}; health lists a hold only while the error is unchanged. Operator release retries through the existing release helper or drops with an operator-dropped reason.
